active.model: player's own rate blended 45/55 with the posted line
probability capped at the posted price (Week 9 lesson)
wide normal draw around the blended mean

tests.name: last-5 vs season rate, 2025 receptions
tests.result: season MAE 1.25, last-5 MAE 1.26. Season rate matches or beats last-5, so the sim keeps the season rate.

tests.name: Poisson receptions, 2025
tests.result: Brier of P(over the season rate) is 0.24. Kept. A boosted tree was checked next.

tests.name: XGBoost receptions, 2025 holdout
tests.result: season rate matched or beat the tree, so the tree stays off the board MAE season 1.245, last-5 1.263, tree 1.2630000114440918.

tests.name: last-5 vs season rate, 2025 receiving yards
tests.result: season MAE 16.54, last-5 MAE 17.02. Season rate matches or beats last-5, so the sim keeps the season rate.

tests.name: Gamma vs normal, 2025 receiving yards
tests.result: Weeks finished over the season rate 40.5% of the time. A Gamma(shape 4) says 56.7%. A normal centered on the rate says 50%. The normal is closer, so yards stay on the current draw.
